fr_html: Si un juge suppléant devait prendre la place d'un juge décédé ou démissionnaire, on arriverait facilement à priver de représentation certains Etats qui doivent être représentés à la Cour.
en_html: If a deputy judge were to take the place of a judge who had died or retired, it might easily come to pass, that certain States which ought to be represented on the Court would be deprived of such representation.
